{{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}}

::: {#exr-child-break-jacket}
Human staffing for a project or enterprise has dimension C (that is, [capita]). Human effort expended in completing a project has dimension C T, reflecting that a person needs time to accomplish anything.

What is the relationship between staffing and human effort?

```{mcq}
#| label: cbj-1-uwd
1. Staffing is proportional to effort expended. [hint: Sorry. Staffing and effort have different dimensions.]
2. Staffing is the derivative of effort with respect to time. [correct]
3. Staffing is the accumulation of effort with respect to time. [hint: No. Since effort has dimension CT, the accumulation of effort with respect to time would have dimension C T^2^.]
4. Staffing and effort have unrelated dimensions.
```
:::
 <!-- end of exr-child-break-jacket -->
